commonSubstance.scienceAndMethods: Mathematics actually covers matrices, complex/eigen quantities and discrete/continuous dynamic systems. BigBangtoLife is substantive cosmology, relativity, quantum/atomic/molecular and biological/evolutionary/laboratory inquiry; it is not generic sustainability context. Programming includes Python, scientific algorithms, AI-social critique and argumentation. Emergence explicitly integrates philosophical history with networks, probabilistic/nonlinear mathematical models and simulation across natural and social examples.
commonSubstance.humanAndSocial: StatesandPeople develops political, sociological, psychological and anthropological accounts of order/conflict and state power. Cognition includes neural systems, empirical neuroscience, learning, language, consciousness and microscopy. TheCity is actual urban/economic geography, gentrification/displacement/inequality and Amsterdam field inquiry; no generic social-theory course automatically reproduces it. PhilosophyofScience includes verification/falsification/paradigms, representation, situatedknowledge and interdisciplinary inquiry.
commonSubstance.research: Methods6 combines sampling, linear/logistic regression, R and qualitative data/thematic Atlas.ti analysis. Project1 develops and executes multidisciplinary team inquiry, expertinterview, report and symposium; participation requires methods followed. Project3 analyses disciplinary grounding/common ground/integration in actual interdisciplinary research and requires Project1 passed. Project2 consultant teams apply circular-economy transitions, literature and stakeholder analysis to an external client, report and presentation. These are substantive methods, not generic transferable skills.
